B.Tech. IV Semester Supplementary Examinations, December 2024/January 2025

Database Management Systems
(Common to CSE, IT, CSB, CSM and CSD)

Time: 3 Hours Answer ALL Questions Max. Marks: 60
Part-A (10 x 1 = 10 Marks

Explain Entity set with suitable example.

What are the most common errors you can potentially face in data
modeling?

List the constraints in relation model.

Describe different operators in relational algebra.
Discuss different types of SQL operators.
Illustrate UNION and INTERSECT in SQL.
Name the disadvantages of Time stamp protocol.
Classify the Lock based protocol.

Explain memory storage device hierarchy.
Mention the objectives of file organization.

Part-B (5 x 10 = 50 Marks
Stem of the Question
Outline Database — System Applications in detail.
What are five main functions of a Database administrator?
OR
Compare Weak Entity Set and Strong Entity Set with example.
Design an ER diagram for a Hospital management system that
includes entities such as patients, employees, doctors, nurses,
room, receptionist, test report, and billing. Specify the
relationships between these entities and their attributes.

Describe constraints on a single relationship.
Explain Tuple Relation Calculus with example.

OR
Write the given queries in SQL
student(Roll-number, Name, Address, Age, Phone)
i. Select names of all students who stay in Delhi.
ii. Find the name, Roll-number of all students in ascending order
by age.
iii. Select Name, Address, AVG (age) from student based on
Address.
i. Develop Salesman Table (salesperson ID, name, city and 1,2,3,12
commission).
ii. Create a view to Update the city name which salesperson ID is
'5007'.".

Write the given queries in SQL

Sailors(sid: integer, sname: string, rating: integer, age: real);
Boats(bid: integer, bname: string, color: string);

Reserves(sid: integer, bid: integer, day: date).

i. Find the ids and names of sailors who have reserved two
different boats on the same day.
